chunks.text:
[Intro - the clock]
{a dry ticking pulse on every eighth note, like a clock or a metronome, and one soft felt piano note on each downbeat; almost nothing else; quiet and exact}

[Build]
{a warm analog synth arpeggio enters under the tick, a soft bass pulse joins, rising, a short riser into the next downbeat}

[Drop]
{kick drum and hand claps land on the downbeat, a full, clean groove; the arpeggio and a bright, simple melody on top}

[Peak]
{the melody climbs an octave, fuller chords, open hi-hats, the biggest and brightest part of the piece}

[Ending]
{the drums drop out, the arpeggio and the tick for one bar, then one final full-band chord hit on the downbeat that rings out and decays to complete silence}
